name: @johnmorrisdotca/hata
description: Hata 旗 — Country and region flags as SVG: country, regional and former-country flags (the Soviet Union, Yugoslavia and more), native ratios and curated frames, source/author/licence metadata, one module per flag, lazy loading and an optional custom element. Zero dependencies.
author: John Morris

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsup && node scripts/build-extras.ts
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && node scripts/check-docs.mjs && pnpm test && node scripts/check-package.mjs
scripts.test:demo: pnpm site && node scripts/docs-site.mjs build && playwright test
